Product Features

  • Drawer LED bedside tables included: Spacious drawers with vintage-style metal handles are another decorative highlight of this bed.Interior dimensions of the bedside table:31Wx23.5Dx6H. An LED night light on each side. These lamps are switched on and off using a toggle switch. This allows you to read comfortably at dusk and then turn off the lights without having to get out of bed again.
  • The charging function at the head of the bed: At the head of the bed, there are built-in USB/Type-C ports and European plugs. These thoughtful additions not only illustrate the harmonious combination of modern comfort and sophisticated aesthetics, but also serve as evidence of the careful consideration of different charging needs.
  • Cosy eye-catcher: The striking construction of the bed corresponds perfectly with the eye-catching structure of the wood décor. The result is a successful combination of rustic modernity and sophistication.The comfort height of the bed allows you to get in and out of the bed in a way that is easy on your back. At the spacious headboard, you can enjoy cozy evening hours.
  • Comfortable and Sturdy: The sturdy slatted base not only ensures maximum comfort, but also provides an airflow margin to extend the life of the mattress, making the bed both comfortable and economical.
  • Modern floating bed: Large design at a low price.The sleeping area inspires with its floating look, which is created by crossbars that are set far inwards. The bed gets the final touch from the wild oak setting on the headboard.
  • This product link includes two floating night tables that can be attached directly to the headboard and a separate double bed frame. The bedside table is removable. **The 140/160/180 size bed frame and matching bedside table are shipped in three packages and can arrive on different days.***
